name: Keoni
source:
Sengoku. Main character belongs to the Iga clan and gets a mission to kill his brother who abandoned Iga. Among Kyoto forces, Koga clan assassins, prostitutes and all kinds of shady characters protagonist discovers the darkness of this world.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
战国时代。主人公隶属伊贺一族，受命杀死背叛伊贺的哥哥。置身京都势力、甲贺刺客、妓女及形形色色的可疑人物之间，主人公逐渐发现这个世界的黑暗。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-december-2003-saya-no-uta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
